editorial:
You follow a flashy vlogger and his friends as they fly to Moscow chasing bigger views and wilder content. The trip starts like a party, with bright lights, loud music, and that "anything for the camera" energy. But the mood shifts fast when their extreme escape-room style adventure turns into a real nightmare. The city feels cold and dangerous, and every choice they make seems to pull them deeper into trouble. You can feel the pressure of social media fame pushing them past common sense, and that makes the scares hit harder.

The acting is solid, especially when panic sets in, and the pacing keeps you moving from one tense moment to the next. The traps and chase scenes are intense, though some twists are easy to guess and a few characters make frustrating choices. If you like horror that mixes modern internet culture with survival thrills, this is a fun late-night watch. Just don't expect a deep story; expect a wild ride.
endingExplained: In the final stretch, Cole realizes the danger is not just a game and fights back against his captor. After a brutal showdown, he escapes the trap-filled location and survives, but not everyone in his group makes it out. The last scene shows him back in front of the camera, still chasing views, which leaves you wondering if he learned anything at all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves social-media horror and survival thrillers.
